what: Continue to build (the quote), Build and play; wait for Play; read the world's history (genesis + pack event)

actions.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const t = document.body.innerText; if (/Cost:/.test(t)) break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('What building asks'); return t.slice(Math.max(0, at), at + 1500) })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 240; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return { ms: Math.round(performance.now() - window.__t0), instance: s.activeInstance.instance?.instanceId ?? null }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout: ' + document.body.innerText.slice(0, 1500) })()

(async () => { const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const n = H.worldNow(); const P = (await import('/engine/playerProbe.ts')).samplePlayer(); return JSON.stringify({ world: n?.world ?? null, head: n?.head, pack: n?.pack ?? null, chunks: n && Object.keys(n.chunks), chapters: n && Object.keys(n.chapters), p: P && [P.x, P.z] }) })()
